evaluation.human_evals: The developer reports using MT-Bench and Alpaca-Eval with advanced LLMs as judges, and states that the models do not produce overly long responses to exploit LLM judge biases.
evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the Qwen1.5 series performs strongly within a 32K token context, with the largest chat variant surpassing several open and proprietary baselines on chat benchmarks. The 32K results are described as strong but not as a limit of the models' supported context length.

identity.name: Qwen1.5-32B-Chat
identity.summary: Qwen1.5 is a language model series that includes decoder-only models of different sizes, with base and chat variants released across multiple parameter counts.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: chat model with reported chat benchmark results but no reported factuality/grounding evaluation in the card summary

specifications.model_size: 60.6 GiB of safetensors weights (65,024,525,272 bytes) in BF16
